why: The conjecture itself remains open, but the lower bound on the minimum size of a counterexample (a quantity the problem's own literature tracks) has been repeatedly improved post-snapshot, e.g. to 24 vertices via SAT search and then to 58-60 vertices in 2026, and the conjecture has been verified for new graph classes (P10-free in 2024, P13-free in 2025).
